# QR Me - Contact

> QR Me - Contact is an iOS and Android app to easily share your contact information with a QR code.

## Summary

QR Me - Contact is the fastest and easiest way to share your contact information. 
Use the app to generate a QR code of your contact. The QR code encodes your information as a vCard.
When someone scans it, their phone will open their Contacts app and load in your contact information. Shares instantly with no internet required - perfect for conferences with bad Wi-Fi.

Access your QR code even quicker by using the QR Me widget to see your QR code on your home screen.

Contact information is stored directly within the QR code and on the user's device. Carnaroli Software LLC does not collect personal information entered into the app.

## Product Facts

- Available for iOS and Android.
- Creates QR codes that encode contact information directly.
- QR codes can be scanned by regular phone cameras.
- Recipients do not need to install QR Me to scan a shared code.
- Works offline because contact data is stored in the QR code.
- Free version supports one black-and-white QR code with all contact fields, unlimited scans, and unlimited edits.
- Professional Branding Upgrade adds multiple QR codes, custom colors, and logo overlays.
- Premium pricing shown on the site: $1.99/month, $12.99/year with 3-day free trial, or $25 lifetime; prices may vary by location. See the App Store for current prices.

## Privacy Facts

- Contact information entered in the app is stored locally on the user's device.
- Carnaroli Software LLC does not collect personal information entered into the app.
- In-app purchases are managed by Apple, Google, and RevenueCat.
- Anonymous and aggregated usage or purchase-related data may be visible through third-party services, but not personally identifiable contact data.
